test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Two trains P and Q start from stations S and T towards each other. Train P takes 4 hours 48 minutes and train Q takes 3 hours 20 minutes to reach T and S, respectively, after they meet. If the speed of train P is 45 km/h, what is the speed of train Q?
solution:
**Given:**

After meeting, trains P and Q complete their journey in 4 hours 48 minutes and 3 hours 20 minutes respectively

Speed of train P = 45 km/hr

**Formula used:**

After meeting each other, the time required by the trains to reach the destination

(S₁)/(S₂) = sqrt{(T₂)/(T₁)} 

Where, S₁ and S₂ are the speeds of trains, and T₁ and T₂ are the times taken by trains to reach the destination after meeting

**Calculation:**

4 hours 48 minutes = 24/5 hours

3 hours 20 minutes = 10/3 hours

According to the question,

(45)/(S₂) = sqrt{((10/3))/((24/5))} 

⇒ (45)/(S₂) = sqrt{(10×5)/(24×3)} 

⇒ (45)/(S₂) = (5)/(6)

⇒ S₂ = (45 × 6)/5 = 54

**∴ The speed of Q is 54 km/hr.**
